title: Fire catalogue
description: contract/catalog.json: every component, class, attribute value, element, event, icon, token and template of Fire, generated by scripts/build-catalog.mjs. Facts come from the source; each component's card holds the judgement.

fire.description: Fire version, without a pre-release suffix.

modules.description: JS-only parts with no CSS root class (an email renderer, helper functions, the theme record): each has a card in contract/cards/<id>.json. Not Facet components.

module.description: Path of the ES module from the repository root.

exports.description: Names the module exports, read from its source.

classes.description: Every fd- class defined by Fire's CSS, mapped to the id of the one component it belongs to.

events.description: Every fd:* event a behaviour module documents. detail is the generic shape (core.js) or the first module's; shapes lists what each module writes.

globalAttributes.description: Layout attributes that work on any element (fire/layout.css), with their values.

attributes.description: data-* attribute name to the values Fire defines for it, each with evidence tied to the component (a style rule, a VOCABULARY entry, a comment or script line naming one of its classes, or a documented default). "" is the bare presence form (data-icon-only); the single value "*" marks a free attribute that takes any value.

root.description: The class that makes the component; every class of the component starts with it, or is a part the vocabulary names.

classes.description: Every class of the component, root included, sorted.

attributes.description: What a person picks for the component: values on its root class or its element. Facet offers these as props.

partAttributes.description: Values on one of the component's other classes (a part, or a member of a group), by class: they are valid on an element carrying that class, and are not props of the component.

stateAttributes.description: Attributes Fire's scripts set as state on the component or its parts (data-state on open, data-indicator, data-overflow, data-dragging…): the lint accepts them in markup, Facet does not offer them as props.

element.description: Tag name of the custom element that renders the component, or null.

events.description: fd:* events the component's module documents for it.

docs.description: docs/<page>.html#<section>, or null when no docs section uses the root.

element.description: A custom element, reduced from contract/custom-elements.json.
